card.name: The digit 2 in converted numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 2 (sometimes 5 or 9) at the start or middle of a number inside parentheses, usually a metric conversion or a count after 'about' or 'approximately'.

modes.label: Metric conversions
modes.description: A digit 2 starts the converted figure in parentheses after miles or mi.
modes.example: approximately 14 mi (<<2>>3 km) east of Portland

modes.label: Approximate multiples or amounts
modes.description: A digit 2 follows 'about' or 'approximately' in a rough quantity.

modes.label: Trial counts and percentages
modes.description: A digit inside a count, percentage or confidence interval in parentheses.
